rows.expected: During `radial`, `aiming`, `flying` or `carrying`, pinching "Sample" leaves the selected garden and real ledger unchanged and shows "Finish pinning or moving this sprout before switching gardens.". Completing/cancelling the current action permits a later toggle.
rows.observed: Sample-switch guard was not exercised separately during radial, aiming, flying and carrying.

rows.expected: Toggling Sample off shows "Back to your real garden.", restores only real anchored sprouts with their original IDs/positions/stages and preserves every real count. Reload while sample is on starts in real mode with sample false and no sample records persisted.
rows.observed: Sample-off restored real IDs/positions/history, but reload while sample remained on was not driven.

driverChecks.name: sample garden off: real history untouched

rows.expected: Enter sample mode during a real running block: the real startedAt/minutes remain unchanged. If its wall-clock end passes while viewing sample, exactly one real block settles; returning to real mode shows that one stone, with no sample focus blocks merged into history.
rows.observed: Real timer completion while viewing sample was not driven.

rows.expected: One pinch on a real sprout's wooden stake enters `carrying`, closes Week and shows "Carrying. Pinch a new spot to move it, or pinch the tray to remove it (its history stays).". The same selecting pinch does not immediately drop, archive or check in that sprout.
rows.observed: One stake pinch entered carrying with the exact toast, Week closed, and no check-in, immediate drop or archive occurred.

rows.expected: After selecting the stake, one pinch on a new detected surface creates a new anchor within 2 cm of the hit, deletes the old live/persistent anchor, retains habit ID/count history/stage and shows the habit label plus " moved to: " and the new surface label. Mode returns to `idle`; exactly one sprout remains.
rows.observed: Move succeeded with a new handle, unchanged history and one sprout; exact deletion of the old persistent handle was not captured.

rows.expected: Moving a horizontal fern/maple/bamboo habit onto a wall changes species to moss; moving it back to a horizontal surface restores its preset species. Completed-day total and growth stage do not change; the visible root orientation follows each hit normal.
rows.observed: Horizontal fern/maple/bamboo→wall→horizontal species matrix was not driven.

rows.expected: Dropping into empty space shows "No real surface there, so it stays where it was.". A failed new anchor shows "Could not move it: " plus the runtime reason. In either case old placement/handle and all counts remain unchanged, no extra anchor leaks, and mode returns to `idle`.
rows.observed: Missing move hit and genuine new-anchor rejection were not driven.

rows.expected: Select a stake, then pinch the tray once: active habit/sprout/live anchor counts each decrease by 1, archivedDay is today's local date, placement is null and one seed slot is freed. For Stretch the toast is "Stretch is back in the tray as a seed. Its history is kept (export includes it).".
rows.observed: Tray drop archived Stretch on the actual local day, nulled placement, freed one slot and removed one active habit/sprout/live anchor; exact history-kept toast captured.

rows.expected: Reload after archiving: the archived sprout/ring does not reappear, its complete counts remain in JSON export, and the freed slot can plant a new distinct habit ID without overwriting the archived history.
rows.observed: Archived history stayed exported after reload and the sprout stayed absent; later planting into the freed slot was not driven.

rows.expected: With MAX_HABITS = 6, six active anchored habits plus one tray use 7 of Meta's 8 persistent slots. A seventh seed attempt creates 0 new habits/anchors and shows "All 6 habits are planted. Pinch a sprout’s wooden stake, then pinch the tray to free a seed."; the full-tray hint reads "6 of 6 habits · move a sprout into the tray to free a seed".
rows.observed: Six anchored habits and the full hint were captured. The attempted full-tray centre pinch hit sand and showed the rake hint, so the required seventh-seed refusal was not observed.

rows.expected: With six habits, one move may temporarily use the eighth slot and returns to 7 including the tray after deleting the old anchor. Rapid duplicate placement/drop pinches do not exceed 8 reserved/live slots, duplicate a history mutation or create a seventh active habit.
rows.observed: Capacity move and rapid duplicate pinches with reserved/live slot accounting were not driven.

rows.expected: One tray "Contrast" pinch sets highContrast true, highlights the control, shows "High contrast on." and redraws menu/cards/sand using black, white and yellow (#ffe14d) contrast styling. A second restores false and "High contrast off." with the original colours.
rows.observed: Contrast on/off settings and exact toasts observed; reviewed on-state screenshot shows black/white/yellow cards and highlighted Contrast.

rows.expected: One tray "Large" pinch sets largeTargets true, highlights the control and shows "Larger targets on.". Seed and sprout-label/stake scale is ×1.4, radial and Pin again cards are ×1.2, menu height and wrist card scale are ×1.4; rays/pokes hit the enlarged visible targets. Toggling off restores ×1 and "Larger targets off.".

rows.expected: Enable Contrast, Large and One-hand together, reload and re-enter: all three booleans remain true, all menu highlights match, labels retain contrast/size and undo chips remain single-pinch. Disabling each persists its false value independently without changing history or anchors.
rows.observed: Three settings persisted together and disabled independently with history unchanged; actual combined-settings undo-chip single-pinch action was not driven.

rows.expected: First pinch unlocks synthesized Web Audio; rooting produces the two-note root chime, partial counted check-in a tap, growth a rising three-note chime and undo a descending two-note chime. No sound asset download occurs and 0 audio-related page errors occur.

rows.observed: Web Audio unavailable case was not exercised.
